config.sqlTemplate: SELECT sum(bytes_on_disk) AS bytes FROM system.parts WHERE active AND database = 'default' AND table LIKE 'otel_%'
SELECT sum(rows) AS rows FROM system.parts WHERE active AND database = 'default' AND table LIKE 'otel_%'
SELECT count() AS parts FROM system.parts WHERE active AND database = 'default' AND table LIKE 'otel_%'
SELECT if(count() = 0, 0, round(quantile(0.95)(query_duration_ms), 1)) AS p95_ms FROM system.query_log WHERE type = 'QueryFinish' AND is_initial_query AND $__timeFilter(event_time)

SELECT $__timeInterval(event_time) AS ts, sum(written_rows) AS rows, count() AS inserts FROM system.query_log WHERE type = 'QueryFinish' AND query_kind = 'Insert' AND $__timeFilter(event_time) GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

SELECT $__timeInterval(event_time) AS ts, round(quantile(0.5)(query_duration_ms), 1) AS p50, round(quantile(0.95)(query_duration_ms), 1) AS p95, round(quantile(0.99)(query_duration_ms), 1) AS p99 FROM system.query_log WHERE type = 'QueryFinish' AND is_initial_query AND $__timeFilter(event_time) GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

SELECT table AS table_name, formatReadableQuantity(sum(rows)) AS rows, formatReadableSize(sum(bytes_on_disk)) AS on_disk, round(sum(data_compressed_bytes) / greatest(sum(data_uncompressed_bytes), 1), 3) AS ratio FROM system.parts WHERE active AND database = 'default' AND table LIKE 'otel_%' GROUP BY table ORDER BY sum(bytes_on_disk) DESC
SELECT table AS table_name, extract(engine_full, 'TTL ([^ ]+(?: [^ ]+){0,3})') AS ttl FROM system.tables WHERE database = 'default' AND table LIKE 'otel_%' AND engine_full LIKE '%TTL%' ORDER BY table

SELECT table AS table_name, count() AS active_parts, formatReadableSize(sum(bytes_on_disk)) AS on_disk, max(modification_time) AS newest_part FROM system.parts WHERE active AND database = 'default' AND table LIKE 'otel_%' GROUP BY table ORDER BY active_parts DESC

SELECT event_time, round(query_duration_ms, 1) AS duration_ms, formatReadableSize(memory_usage) AS memory, substring(query, 1, 120) AS query FROM system.query_log WHERE type = 'QueryFinish' AND is_initial_query AND $__timeFilter(event_time) ORDER BY query_duration_ms DESC LIMIT 25
SELECT sum(free_space) AS free_bytes FROM system.disks
SELECT sum(total_space) AS total_bytes FROM system.disks
SELECT sum(bytes_on_disk) AS bytes FROM system.parts WHERE active AND database = 'default' AND table NOT LIKE 'otel_metrics_%' AND table LIKE 'otel_%'
SELECT sum(bytes_on_disk) AS bytes FROM system.parts WHERE active AND database = 'default' AND table LIKE 'otel_metrics_%'

SELECT if(table LIKE 'otel_metrics_%', 'infra', 'app') AS family, table AS table_name, formatReadableQuantity(sum(rows)) AS rows, formatReadableSize(sum(bytes_on_disk)) AS on_disk FROM system.parts WHERE active AND database = 'default' AND table LIKE 'otel_%' GROUP BY family, table_name ORDER BY sum(bytes_on_disk) DESC

tiles.name: Writes per minute: app vs infra

config.sqlTemplate: SELECT $__timeInterval(event_time) AS ts, if(tables[1] LIKE 'default.otel_metrics_%', 'infra', 'app') AS family, sum(written_rows) AS rows FROM system.query_log WHERE type = 'QueryFinish' AND query_kind = 'Insert' AND $__timeFilter(event_time) GROUP BY ts, family ORDER BY ts
